items.title: Tony Pollard: Titans reportedly not interested in trade
items.text:
While Pollard has reportedly drawn interest from teams looking for running back help ahead of the NFL's upcoming trade deadline, Albert Breer of SI.com, Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport note via ESPN.com that the Titans are not interested in trading him.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Listed as doubtful, reportedly pushing to play
items.text:
Skattebo (hamstring) -- who is officially listed as doubtful --  "is trying to push to play" Sunday against the Eagles, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN.

items.title: Hunter Henry: Has 'realistic chance' to play
items.text:
Henry (foot) "has a realistic chance to play" Sunday against the Packers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Staying in trade buzz
items.text:
The Colts have an offer of "at least a second-round pick and more" on the table for Taylor but are "holding out for more," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
